title: Laya (OS Jev) on Mac M4 CoreML Offline (45 decisions per second)
originalTitle: Laya (OS Jev) on Mac M4 CoreML Offline (45 decisions per second)
content:
Nice! I just wanted to see what Laya does and put it behind Cloudflare's typesafe/jev API:

curl https://laya.inference.zaitlabs.com/ai/run \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{
 "state": "Help! My payouts have been failing for 3 days.",
 "questions": {
 "is_urgent": {"type": "noul", "instructions": "Does this convey urgency?"}
 }
  }'
{"answers":{"is_urgent":{"type":"noul","noul":0.7894}}}

https://laya.inference.zaitlabs.com/terms
